title: A deteriorating-cohort borrower's forecast crossing is dated within the labelled window
note: Borrower B-000001 is authored into the deteriorating cohort of the reference portfolio (seed 17, 24 borrowers); its labelled utilisation-threshold crossing date is derived from its own generated signal trajectory by evaluation.reference_portfolio.labels.derive_labels, never typed into this file. spec §17.7's forecast-dating pass mark is a first crossing dated within +/-10 days of that label -- the harness resolves the label at run time and this example survives a full portfolio regeneration untouched.
